rows.en:
(Hey, you!
What kind of thing is that to think?
About the guy who saved your life!
I knew all along, you know.
I knew you tried to sacrifice me, too.
But forget it. I'm the one who let Kanda pass on, after all.
I'm not human. I'm only borrowing a human form.
What am I, you ask?{p}
...Heh heh, let's just say I'm an extraterrestrial life-form. A good man ought to keep plenty of mystery about him, after all.){p}

Kazama's voice echoed in my head.
Was this telepathy?
K-Kazama, what are you saying?
Maybe the reason Kazama always acted so strangely was to fool the eyes of the world.
Kazama, just what are you...?{p}

Then I looked down at Motoki, who lay collapsed in my arms.
She was still unconscious.
...What should I do?
Then Kazama laid a hand on Motoki's head and focused his energy with a sharp shout.
It seemed she had come to.{p}

"...What happened to me?
Don't tell me... did somebody die?"
Motoki said, looking as if she might burst into tears at any moment.
I gave her a quick summary of everything that had happened.{p}

"...I see. Thank goodness.
I was so scared someone might have died.
So there are times even Grandma can't save people, huh."
Motoki looked relieved.
Kazama was watching over her, too.
Then she looked at Kazama and said,
"...Was it you who saved everyone?
Thank you."
And so, thanks to Motoki and Kazama, everyone was safe.
It was all over.{p}

...Every one of them seems like the culprit.
...But there's no solid proof.
I have to offer up one of them as a victim.
Either way, do I really have to name one person here...?
And so, I made my decision.{p}

rows.en: ...Makoto Shindo.{p}

No... now that I really think about it, I can't choose just one person after all.
What am I supposed to do☆
(What's the matter?
Choose, quickly...
Or else...)
His voice rang inside my head.
Then the man who must have been Kanda came into the club room, moving stiffly, like a robot.
(Quickly... choose quickly.)
It was hopeless.
Just then, someone shouted from the club room doorway.{p}

It was Hino.
He must have come to check on us, I thought.
But how could Hino tell right away it was Kanda, when he had no head?
I could plainly see the blood draining from Hino's face.
His teeth were chattering so hard I could hear them.{p}

"So you've come back because you hate me...
No wonder you can't rest in peace.
But it's your own fault, too☆
You were the one who treated me like I didn't matter..."
As he said this, Hino wept, tears pouring down his face.{p}

"We were such good friends, weren't we?
And then what?
You went and lost your head over girls...
I couldn't stand it anymore, so I confessed my feelings to you.
But after that, you started avoiding me.
You looked at me like I was something filthy.
You could accept Iwashita's feelings and Fukuzawa's, but you couldn't accept mine☆
Why did you reject me☆"
Then Hino threw his arms around the headless Kanda.
"You're the one person I will never let anyone else have☆"
With that, Hino lifted him up in his arms.{p}

"Even now that you're like this.
I still love you, you know."
Hino rubbed his cheek against the torn stump of Kanda's neck.
So very lovingly...
Then, still holding him, Hino ran off down the hallway.{p}

Even Iwashita and Fukuzawa, of all people, were at a loss for words.
...So Hino was someone who couldn't love the opposite sex.
But come to think of it, the only difference is whether it's the opposite sex or the same sex. Maybe it doesn't matter who a person loves.
Motoki spoke up.{p}

"Looks like even Grandma didn't see this coming.
But I'm glad you're safe, {a}.
Really..."
I held her hand even tighter, as if to make sure it was there.
She was smiling.
I gave a big nod.
It was all over.{p}

...Then a week went by.
Since that day, I never saw them again.
Hino was found drowned in the river that runs beside the school.
In the end, it was apparently ruled a suicide and the matter was closed, but...{p}

...Every one of them seemed like the culprit.
...But there was no solid proof.
I had to pick one victim from among them.
Either way, if I didn't name someone here, everyone might be killed.
And so, I decided.{p}

rows.en:
...Hosoda.
He must resent Kanda terribly.
How much he must have hated him for taking Fukuzawa, the girl he loved.
He's just the type to fall into a persecution complex like, 'He stole my girlfriend'...
...That's right, maybe Hosoda killed Kanda.
So it would only be natural for Kanda to haunt him to death.
I was trying to justify to myself the fact that I had chosen him.{p}

And then...
(It's Tomoharu Hosoda...)
I murmured inside my head.
(...Understood.)
A voice that seemed to be a reply echoed in my head.{p}

Then the figure that must have been Kanda began to walk, stiff as a robot.
Pat... pat... His footsteps echoed as he walked around everyone.
Everyone had their eyes shut and their fists clenched tight.
I could almost hear them all screaming, don't stop behind me.
...Is he really going to kill the person I named?
Kanda kept walking for a while.
How could he walk so well without a head?
Could he sense his way?
Either way, he was no longer of this world.
Then he stopped dead behind Hosoda.
S-so I was right.
It was true.{p}

Just then, the lights suddenly went out.
At the same moment, I heard a horrible scream and a sound like something being snapped in two.
It's not a good feeling, something happening in the dark.
Something was definitely happening, yet I couldn't even move.
Then, before long, the lights came back on.{p}

"Aagh☆"
We let out soundless screams.
There lay Hosoda's corpse, its head wrenched off.
Blood was still spurting from the arteries of the torn neck.
The body seemed to still be twitching.
And we froze.{p}

Kanda was standing in the club room doorway.
Cradling Hosoda's head in both hands...
Kanda lifted the head to attach it to his own body, but immediately tossed it away onto the floor.
Hosoda's head rolled like a ball until it bumped against its own body and stopped.
(No good. Even if he's the guy who killed me, a head like this won't save me!)
Just as Kanda took a step toward us!{p}

Hosoda's head floated softly up into the air.
(How mean of you.)
Hosoda's head flew circles around Kanda's body, apparently complaining about something.
(What's wrong with my head, huh?
Don't go saying such rude things.)
With that, Hosoda's head forced itself onto Kanda's body.{p}

Before long, a bitter, frustrated groan resounded through the club room, and at the same moment, Kanda's body vanished.
Only Hosoda's head remained, floating in the air.
Then once again, Hosoda's voice came into my head.
(What a nasty person.
He hasn't changed one bit, even after dying.
Getting killed by me twice... Heh heh heh, poor thing.){p}

Hosoda was watching me with a creepy smile.
({a}, I won't forget today.
Not ever...)
The next moment, Hosoda's headless body sat bolt upright.
He clutched his own head tightly in his arms, went out into the hallway, and ran off at a terrifying speed.{p}
Where could he be going?{p}

After Hosoda was gone, the club room fell silent.
No one said anything.
I squeezed Motoki's hand, which I'd been holding without realizing it.
She was staring straight into my eyes.
They were eyes that seemed to know everything in my heart.{p}

Was I really right to name him?
But Kanda had said it.
That Hosoda had killed him...
And Hosoda himself admitted it, didn't he?
Still, Hosoda seemed to know that I was the one who named him as the sacrifice.
If he holds a grudge over that...
My life is in danger★{p}

We agreed that what happened here would stay a secret among the seven of us.
Well, even without such a promise, no one would ever tell anyone.
Telling wouldn't change anything, and it seemed the others hadn't heard Kanda's voice or the words of Hosoda's head anyway.
Besides me, only one other person, Motoki, probably understood.
The truth of what happened was recorded only in the hearts of the two of us.
Hosoda remains missing.
When I think he could appear in front of me at any moment, it makes me uneasy, but...{p}

For now, a week has passed without incident.
Maybe it's because she's protecting me?{p}

...Every one of them seems like the culprit.
...But there's no solid proof.
I have to offer up one of them as a victim.
Either way, if I don't name someone here, everyone might be killed.
Just then, a single name suddenly came to mind.{p}

rows.en:
...Shoji Arai.
I don't know why.
He has nothing to do with Kanda...
Of all the members Hino gathered here, he's the only one with no connection to Kanda.
If Hino had some reason for gathering only people connected to Kanda, then maybe this guy has some secret, too...{p}

My curiosity about him grew bigger and bigger inside me.
And in the end, that temptation was read.
(Understood.
Shoji Arai, then...)
A voice that must have been Kanda's rang inside my head.
(N-no!
That's not it! He's...)
Even the scream in my heart was somehow weak.
Maybe my curiosity was stronger...{p}

By the time I snapped to my senses, it was already too late.
The figure that must have been Kanda began to walk, stiff as a robot, and circled around everyone, his footsteps echoing, pat... pat...
Was he looking for Arai...?
Could he really tell who was who without a head...?
Then he stopped dead behind Arai.
Arai had his eyes shut, praying desperately.{p}

Just then, the lights suddenly went out.
At the same moment, I heard a horrible scream and a sound like something being snapped in two.
It's not a good feeling, something happening in the dark.
Something was definitely happening, yet I couldn't even move.
Then, before long, the lights came back on.{p}

"Aagh☆"
We let out soundless screams.
There lay Arai's corpse, its head wrenched off.
Blood was still spurting from the arteries of the torn neck.
The body seemed to still be twitching.
And we froze.{p}

Kanda was standing in the club room doorway.
Yes, wearing the head he had torn off Arai...
(I've got my head.
Anyone would have done.
This head belongs to someone I've never even seen, but it's not bad at all.
It's a shame it isn't the guy who killed me, but now I can finally be saved.)
Kanda was looking at me with Arai's face.{p}
Just then, a voice other than Kanda's... Arai's voice came into my head.{p}

({a}, that's cruel of you.
What is it I'm supposed to have done?
Why did you sacrifice me?)
Oh no, I've done something terrible.
Out of my own curiosity, I killed Arai, who had done nothing wrong.
Kanda, wearing Arai's head, turned his back on us and disappeared into the hallway.{p}

({a}, that's cruel of you.)
Arai's voice stayed in my ears, on and on.
What if I had named someone else...?
If it was going to come to this, maybe I should have been the sacrifice myself.{p}

When I glanced over, Motoki was crying.
Not just Motoki.
Everyone seemed to feel some guilt that Arai, who had nothing to do with what happened to Kanda, had become the victim.
But this was a result I had brought on.
It came to this because I was the one who chose him in the first place.{p}
I have to take responsibility...{p}

"Everyone, thank you for today."
That was all I said. I bowed, hoisted Arai's headless corpse onto my back, and dashed out of the club room as fast as I could.
They must all have been stunned.
But I couldn't die in there.
I didn't want to cause them any more trouble.
I ran...{p}

Suddenly, Arai's corpse moved.
Its hands were trying to strangle me.
(Go ahead.
I'm the one who killed you, after all...)
Then, from somewhere, I heard Arai's voice.
(I'm glad to hear you say that, {a}.
Now I can be saved, too...)
The hands around my neck tightened.
As my consciousness faded, I thought dimly.
The one who will save my soul is...{p}

...Every one of them seemed like the culprit.
...But there was no solid proof.
I had to pick one victim from among them.
Either way, if I didn't name someone here, everyone might be killed.
And so, I decided.{p}

rows.en:
...Fukuzawa.
She hates Iwashita intensely.
Because of Iwashita, she must have resented him at times, too.
All the more because she loved him...
...That's right, maybe Fukuzawa killed Kanda.
I was trying to justify to myself the fact that I had chosen her.{p}

Huh★
What did he just say?
(Wait a minute, that's not what I meant...)
But Kanda's voice no longer came into my head.{p}

In the midst of it all, I alone was thinking.
Who on earth named me...?{p}

It was just my conceit to think that only I could hear Kanda's voice.
...What's that?
I felt like Fukuzawa just looked at me.
Not only Fukuzawa.
Everyone kept stealing glances at me, then looking apologetic.
It was almost as if they were praying to me.
......☆
No way!
Did everyone name me★{p}

(That's right. Seems you're one seriously hated guy.)
Kanda's voice echoed in my head.
It can't be!
I looked at Motoki, who was beside me.{p}

When our eyes met, Motoki said,
"It's okay, I'm right here with you.
Don't worry,"
and smiled.{p}

Easy for her to say, but Kanda was already standing behind me.
I could tell that much without even looking.
...I could feel his presence behind me.
A cold, slimy, clinging, nasty presence...
Agh!
Something chilly just touched the nape of my neck.
It seemed to be Kanda's hand.
Now all I could do was believe Motoki's words.
She's probably the only one who can save me...{p}

The hand Kanda had placed on my neck squeezed harder.
But Motoki just kept smiling and gazing at me.
H... hurry, help...
"Not yet.
First you have to become the sacrifice, {a}, and save everyone here."
Ughk...☆{p}

Kanda's nails, his fingers, dug into my throat...
No good, my head was going hazy.
"Don't worry, I won't let you die.
We'll be together fooooooooorever."
Snap, snap. I could hear blood vessels or nerves or something tearing.
Strangely, there was no pain.
"{a}, get along with Grandpa and Grandma and the others, okay?"
Motoki looked truly happy.{p}

It's true that Motoki and I ended up together.
But you can't call this a marriage.
(Now I'm saved...)
I felt terribly envious of those last words I heard from Kanda.
Will I really be saved...?
Inside Motoki's mouth..........{p}

...Every one of them seems like the culprit.
...But there's no solid proof.
Besides, even if one of them were the culprit, there's no way they'd admit their crime.
But at this rate, we'll all be killed.{p}

rows.en:
Just then, I happened to glance at Motoki.
Make Motoki the victim...{p}

No, I can't do that!
She came here to save us. I can't trample on her kindness like that.
...M-maybe Motoki can do something about this.
She came to save us in the first place, after all...
It's all or nothing now.{p}

"Motoki!
This guy is trying to sacrifice us so he can pass on.
I don't want to sacrifice anyone☆"
I pleaded with her.
Motoki's eyes were fixed on me, piercing.
What on earth was she thinking?
Maybe I had asked her for something far too convenient for me after all...
That's right, what could she possibly do?{p}
"I see... so that's how it is... How dare you trample on my feelings."{p}
